messages:
Clara Nguyen: Quick check 1: compact latency card mock — p95 large, tiny throughput sparkline, 'Sampling' pill top-right that opens a small popover. Attaching a mini-figma. Thoughts on accessibility & copy? :wave:
Devon Park: Looks promising. Ensure throughput has unit 'RPS'. Sampling pill should show mode (Adaptive or 10%) so users don't have to open it. :eyes:
Ravi Patel: Accessibility: pill must be keyboard-focusable with aria-expanded and aria-controls. Popover should use role=\"dialog\" and announce on open via a live region. Add sr-only helper text: 'Sampling reduces plotted traces to improve signal and reduce rendering cost.'
Lena Ortiz: Copy nit: make the pill read "Sampling: Adaptive" (capital A). Popover title: "Sampling settings" and help link text "What is sampling?" linking to docs. For any "est. cost" text prefix with 'Estimated' and include micro-copy: 'For rendered traces only; not a billing line.'
DesignBot: automated-lint: contrast-warning on pill text at current token; recommend stronger text token or bolder weight. :robot_face:
Clara Nguyen: Good notes. I'll update the figma to show pill state, aria snippet, and hide estimated cost behind an opt-in toggle inside the popover. Will post updated link later today. :raised_hands:
